text: I'd put most of the responsibility on governments and large companies. Individuals can recycle or use less plastic, but their impact is tiny compared to factories, power stations and transport systems. Only governments can set rules on emissions or invest in clean energy. That said, individual choices still matter, because politicians tend to act when they see that voters care.

tips.en: I'd put most of the responsibility on picks a side instead of saying “both”.
tips.kk: I'd put most of the responsibility on … — «екеуі де» демей, бір жақты таңдайсыз.
tips.ru: I'd put most of the responsibility on … — вы выбираете сторону, а не «и те, и другие».
tips.example: I'd put most of the responsibility on governments

tips.en: That said adds a concession that makes the view balanced.
tips.kk: That said — соңындағы мойындау ұстанымды салмақты етеді.
tips.ru: That said — уступка в конце делает позицию взвешенной.
tips.example: That said, individual choices still matter

questions.question: Who should be more responsible for protecting the environment — individuals or governments?

text: I think the main obstacle is convenience. In many neighbourhoods there simply aren't separate bins, so even people who want to recycle have nowhere to put things. There's also a lack of trust — some people believe everything ends up in the same landfill anyway. If cities provided proper containers and showed what happens to the waste, I'm sure more people would join in.

tips.en: The main obstacle is convenience names the cause in one word.
tips.kk: The main obstacle is convenience — себеп бір сөзбен аталған.
tips.ru: The main obstacle is convenience — причина названа одним словом.

tips.en: If cities provided uses the second conditional to suggest a way out.
tips.kk: If cities provided … — шешім ұсыну үшін шартты сөйлемнің екінші түрі.
tips.ru: If cities provided … — второй тип условного, чтобы предложить выход.

questions.question: Why don't more people recycle in your country?

text: I'm in favour of banning plastic bags, because there are cheap alternatives and people adapt very quickly — we've seen that in countries that have already done it. Disposable cups are trickier, since cafés and offices depend on them. Rather than an immediate ban, I'd introduce a small charge for each cup, which would encourage people to bring their own.

tips.en: Disposable cups are trickier: the question has two parts, so the answer does too.
tips.kk: Disposable cups are trickier — сұрақ екі бөлікті, жауап та бөлінген.
tips.ru: Disposable cups are trickier — вопрос двойной, и ответ тоже разделён.

tips.en: I'd introduce a small charge offers something realistic instead of a ban.
tips.kk: I'd introduce a small charge — тыйымның орнына шынайы шара ұсынасыз.
tips.ru: I'd introduce a small charge — вместо запрета предлагаете что-то реальное.
tips.example: I'd introduce a small charge for each cup

questions.question: Should plastic bags and disposable cups be banned?

text: For some products, definitely. If I can choose between two similar cleaning products and one doesn't pollute rivers, paying a little extra seems reasonable. The trouble is that eco labels are often misleading, and many families simply can't afford higher prices. So I think governments should make greener options cheaper, instead of expecting consumers to pay the difference.

tips.en: For some products, definitely is followed at once by the cleaning-product example.
tips.kk: For some products, definitely — және бірден жуғыш зат мысалы.
tips.ru: For some products, definitely — и сразу пример с моющим средством.

tips.en: Instead of expecting consumers to pay changes the angle of the question.
tips.kk: Instead of expecting consumers to pay — сұрақтың қырын өзгертетін қорытынды.
tips.ru: Instead of expecting consumers to pay — вывод, который меняет угол вопроса.
tips.example: instead of expecting consumers to pay the difference

questions.question: Is it worth paying more for environmentally friendly products?

text: The best way is through action rather than lectures. Schools can organise things like tree-planting days or a recycling competition between classes, and parents can involve children in sorting rubbish or growing vegetables at home. When children see the results of what they do, the habit sticks. Lessons about climate change are useful too, but on their own they can feel abstract.

tips.en: Through action rather than lectures is a formula answer in the first line.
tips.kk: Through action rather than lectures — бірінші сөйлемдегі жауап-формула.
tips.ru: Through action rather than lectures — ответ-формула в первой фразе.

tips.en: The habit sticks briefly explains why the method works.
tips.kk: The habit sticks — әдістің неге жұмыс істейтінін қысқа түсіндіресіз.
tips.ru: The habit sticks — коротко объясняете, почему метод работает.
